datasets.translation_method: Basic Questions: LLM-based translation (GPT-4o and Claude-3.5 Sonnet) followed by native speaker review and correction. Instructions (47 items): professional human translation by native speakers proficient in English. Both underwent multi-round human quality control.
datasets.annotation_method: Data collected via questionnaire from 31 respondents (researchers, native speakers, linguistics experts), then expanded using GPT-4o and Claude-3.5 Sonnet. 795 Basic Questions combined with 47 templatized Instructions (1-3 per question) to form 18,285 parallel evaluation entries.

data_creator_info.creator_affiliation: Waseda University and OPPO AI Center, Shenzhen, China
data_creator_info.evidence: The total number of questionnaire participants was 31 people, of which 19 were male, 12 were female, most people's age distribution was 21-39 years old, and all respondents had high-frequency usage habits of LLMs. The translations were carried out by internal research team members as part of their responsibilities, thus no additional compensation was involved.

datasets.notes: Each of the 23 languages has 795 parallel data points with 1667 total instructions. Evaluation combines Rule-Based (32 instruction subcategories across 7 categories) and Model-Based (15 instruction subcategories across 4 categories) approaches.
